endorsements.quote: Classify as high risk Record legal basis (health diagnosis/treatment) in project log
Populate Annex IV file set: architecture, test results, certificates
Postmarket monitoring must define clear frameworks for detecting performance drift, integrating user feedback into iterative updates, and managing incidents effectively.
Stress testing with adversarial datasets; human-in-the-loop verification for high-impact decisions; archive adversarial test metrics
Extend ATNA d to record model ID + inference timestamps

Risk management, lacking direct equivalents within MyHealth@EU, must be addressed externally by clearly outlining the risk analysis life cycle, mitigation strategies, hazard modeling, residual risk management, and continuous risk monitoring procedures.
Provide feedback forms linked to IPS b /ePrescription viewers; map feedback IDs to ATNA c audit entries.
This also entails alignment with the MyHealth@EU incident reporting and aggregation system, ensuring timely and standardized communication of serious events across member states.
Refresh Annex IV technical file and rerun conformance tests before redeployment
Input sanitization and context filtering; restrict model to domain-specific prompts; log all inference inputs in ATNA a

unlisted_practices: Embed AI involvement metadata (contribution status, rationale, risk class, Annex IV link) as optional extensions in HL7 CDA and FHIR messages transmitted across borders.
Deploy a human-in-the-loop platform with override option and clearly defined clinical supervisory responsibilities.
Implement a quality management system compliant with ISO standards such as ISO 13485 or ISO/IEC 42001.
Complete conformity assessment via internal or notified-body route and store the certificate.
Prepare and complete registration of high-risk AI systems in the EU database when available.
Run CSP conformance testing on messages before transmission and rerun annually.

screen.reason: This tutorial and framework paper offers guidelines, architectural mappings, and recommendations for developers and healthcare organizations to meet EU AI Act and MyHealth@EU compliance rather than being an empirical evaluation.
